items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: Abe Turchin — I think that was his name — he was the booker for Woody.

ctx.x: I can imagine you at the gas station, the guy’s going, “What are you all doing here?” “Well we play with Woody Herman.” They’d go like, “What’s a Woody Herman?”

Exactly. And one funny thing is when we were on the road, Abe Turchin — I think that was his name — he was the booker for Woody. And he was actually siphoning money from Woody and Woody didn’t realize it. But he booked us in a barn someplace in the south. I’m not sure whether it was in Arkansas, Alabama, someplace. But we were in the hills. And it was a big barn. People came in with coveralls and women with long dresses and wide dresses, and we are playing jazz, and then we’d play dance music too for them. There…
